title: A portion of the Atacama Desert along Peru’s southern Pacific coast
author: NASA/JSC
description: iss074e0315662 (Feb. 13, 2026) --- A portion of the Atacama Desert along Peru’s southern Pacific coast, featuring barren plains, rocky cliffs, vast sand dunes, and fertile river valleys, is pictured from the International Space Station as it orbited 265 miles above the South American nation. Credit: NASA/Chris Williams
